title: An agent, listed
description: One agent or conversation of agents.list.

status.description: Whether it waits for a message, answers one, waits on a person, sleeps until something asks it, or can't start because its saved state can't be read.

problem.description: Why its saved state can't be read while status is unreadable, such as a module it names that this release doesn't have. agent.define starts it over.

pending.description: How many messages wait behind what it's doing.

node.description: The node it runs on, by its name; null while it sleeps.

next_run.description: When the next of its triggers on a clock runs; null where none does.
